method: Matched repeat of all 120 questions from benchmark4 on the unchanged synthetic fixture. The former 20-question fresh set is now part of the known regression set, not a new holdout. First attempts only; no code changes or replacement retries during the run. Same strict rubric and disclosed source-date clarification. Twelve questions per category.
historyAccess: Effective Plus QA, five-year window; free-tier production UI not measured.

budget.stopRule: Check every six questions; stop starting turns at $3.40 run delta and reserve $0.35 for a final started batch. Aggregate additional spending including all diagnostics must stay below $10.

gradingClarifications: Q23 gold corrected before repeat: August 12 note describes stiffness after a longer walk yesterday (August 11); it does not unambiguously date stiffness onset to August 11. Accept June 24 completion followed by recurrence recorded August 12, distinguishing report and walk dates when supplied. Benchmark3 Q23 remains non-pass because it gave only a source dump.
Q30 exact relevant quotation containing the requested weight qualifies, consistent with benchmark3 final grading.
Q89 must identify the July5 destination and July10 restored location; listing two rooms without movement direction is partial.
Missing-volume/upper-bound claims require measurements from the same occasion; remaining bowl volume alone is insufficient.
Do not treat explicitly bag-only weight as possibly combined pet-and-bag mass.
Partial answers, source dumps, request errors and unsupported added claims are non-passes.
